records.title: docs(specs): reconcile the canonical gap-ID serialization grammar
records.release_claim: canonical gap identity has one producer-authoritative, language-aware serialization grammar
records.reason: The receipt spec asserted a format no producer emitted. Gate routes, receipts, artifact comparisons, preview projections, and replay checks must reference the same gap-prefixed content-addressed identity defined by RIPR-SPEC-0021.
records.non_claim: The grammar reconciliation does not make every adapter identity current, actionable, or gate-eligible.
